ahead: The low-values lemma is proved and `#print axioms erdos_359.variants.isGoodFor_1_low_values` reports only [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -- no sorryAx. Three things the next attempt will hit. (1) `erdos_359.parts.i` still carries upstream's deliberate `sorry`; that one is the genuinely open research statement (A k / k -> infinity) and must not be touched. (2) The proof is hand-unrolled, one `have` block per j = 0..6, with the blocked values named by hand (3 at j=1; 6,7 at j=3; 9 at j=4; 11,12,13 at j=5). Pushing past A 7 means writing more blocks by hand and the `interval_cases a <;> interval_cases b` fan-out grows quadratically (28 cases at j=6). A reusable decidable step lemma is the thing to build before extending. (3) `lean/lakefile.toml` has `defaultTargets = ["ZetaLean", "Challenge", "Solution"]`, which does not include the `Erdos` lib, and `.github/workflows/full.yml` runs a bare `lake build` plus a sorry-scan restricted to `ZetaLean/`. So nothing in CI currently builds `lean/Erdos/359.lean`: this proof is verified locally only.

work.what: Extract the per-step greedy recursion in lean/Erdos/359.lean into one reusable lemma so the sequence can be pushed past A 7 without hand-writing a `have` block per index. Today `erdos_359.variants.isGoodFor_1_low_values` proves A 0..A 7 = 1,2,4,5,8,10,14,15 by repeating this shape seven times, once per j: (upper bound) `(hkey j).2` applied to the candidate v, whose membership proof needs `A j < v` plus `forall a b, Finset.Icc a b subset Finset.Iic j -> v <> sum over Finset.Icc a b of A i`, discharged by splitting on `a <= b`, deriving `b <= j` from the subset, and running `interval_cases a <;> interval_cases b <;> simp [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top, h0, ..., hj]`; (lower bound) `(hkey j).1.1 : A j < A (j+1)` together with `(hkey j).1.2 a b _ : A (j+1) <> sum` instantiated at each consecutive block whose sum lands strictly between A j and v, then `omega`. The wanted lemma takes the already-known values A 0 = a0, ..., A j = aj as a list, plus the candidate v, and produces `A (j+1) = v` from a single decidable side condition: v is the least natural above aj that is not a consecutive sum of the list. The `interval_cases` fan-out is 28 cases at j = 6 and grows quadratically, so the decidable formulation is what makes j > 6 affordable.
work.note: IsGoodFor is defined in lean/Erdos/359.lean as: A 0 = n and StrictMono A and forall j, IsLeast {m | A j < m and forall a b, Finset.Icc a b subset Finset.Iic j -> m <> sum over Finset.Icc a b of A i} (A (j+1)).

work.what: Make CI actually build lean/Erdos/. Right now lean/lakefile.toml sets `defaultTargets = ["ZetaLean", "Challenge", "Solution"]` and .github/workflows/full.yml's lean job runs a bare `lake build`, so the `Erdos` lean_lib is never built on CI and lean/Erdos/359.lean could break without anyone noticing. Either add "Erdos" to defaultTargets or have the workflow run `lake build Erdos` explicitly. The zero-sorry guard in that same job greps only `ZetaLean/` and must stay that way, or be given an explicit allowlist entry: `erdos_359.parts.i` in lean/Erdos/359.lean carries a deliberate `sorry` (it is the advertised open statement, A k / k -> infinity) and a naive extension of the grep to lean/Erdos/ would turn the build red for a sorry that is supposed to be there. Note DHChallenge and DHSolution are missing from defaultTargets too, so check whether that is the same gap before changing the file.
